Which X-Men villain manipulated Donald Trask III into deploying Wild Sentinels that massacred nearly the entire population of the mutant nation of Genosha?
questions.explanation: Cassandra Nova, Charles Xavier's twin sister and one of the X-Men's most powerful foes, orchestrated the genocide of Genosha by using Donald Trask III — a descendant of Sentinel creator Bolivar Trask — to activate Wild Sentinels. The attack killed an estimated 16 million mutants, making it one of the darkest events in Marvel Comics history. This storyline was introduced in Grant Morrison's landmark "New X-Men" run beginning in 2001.
